scripts.text: You are not a qualified member. You can not use the bulletin board.
scripts.translation: 您不是符合資格的成員，無法使用任務公告板。

scripts.text: Your level is not qualified. You can not use the bulletin board.
scripts.translation: 您的等級不符合要求，無法使用任務公告板。

scripts.text: There are currently no Escort Missions registered on the board.
scripts.translation: 目前公告板上沒有登記護送任務。

scripts.text: Your level doesn't meet the requirements. You can't take the '{0}' mission.
scripts.translation: 您的等級不符合要求，無法接受“{0}”任務。

scripts.text: You are already doing this mission.
scripts.translation: 你已經在進行這項任務了。

scripts.text: You can get a reward from the client after you finish the mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任務後，可以向委託人領取報酬。

scripts.text: For more details, please press 'Alt + U', to get more information from the Quest Window.
scripts.translation: 如需瞭解詳情，請按“Alt + U”開啟任務視窗。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Wow, you must be a beginner, right?
What an innocent face! Ha~ hahaha.
scripts.translation: 真是一張天真的臉！哈~哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Why don't you do some hunting outside instead of walking around and wasting your time?
scripts.translation: 別在這裡閒逛浪費時間了，去外面狩獵如何？

scripts.text: I am about to leave now.

scripts.translation: 哦，好吧。那你自己看著辦。

scripts.text: Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是伊甸園集團的人嗎？

scripts.text: Wow, I didn't expect you would do that mission. I was just about to give up. But you did good job. I appreciate it!
scripts.translation: 哇，沒想到你真的完成了那項任務。我都快放棄了。你做得很好，真感謝你！

scripts.text: Well, I requested the mission and you did an excellent job.
scripts.translation: 我委託了任務，你也出色地完成了。

scripts.text: I will give you a reward as I promised.
scripts.translation: 我會按照約定給你報酬。

scripts.text: Here it is. Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation: 給你。非常感謝，願神保佑你！

scripts.text: But, you haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come to me now? You haven't completed the mission!
scripts.translation: 可是你還沒完成任務。現在來找我做什麼？任務明明還沒完成！

scripts.text: I will give you a reward if you complete the mission. Ok? Are we good?
scripts.translation: 完成任務後我才會給你報酬，知道了嗎？

scripts.text: You can check the world map by pressing 'ctrl + ~' key.
scripts.translation: 按‘Ctrl + ~’鍵可以檢視世界地圖。

scripts.text: Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation: 總之我會在這裡等你。完成任務後再回來！

scripts.text: Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation: 咦？你確定嗎？好像有哪裡不對...

scripts.text: Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation: 按‘Alt + U’開啟任務視窗確認一下。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Hu hu~~ we are delivery men~
We are faster than any flight~!
scripts.translation: 我們的速度比飛艇還快~！

scripts.text: We are the fastest delivery company, Dieshin Corperation.
scripts.translation: 我們是最快的快遞公司，遞信快遞。

scripts.text: Oh, well. Then, go figure. Bye~!
scripts.translation: 哦，好吧。那你自己看著辦。再見~！

scripts.text: Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是伊甸園集團的人嗎？

scripts.text: Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation: 咦？你確定嗎？好像有哪裡不對...

scripts.text: Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation: 按‘Alt + U’開啟任務視窗確認一下。

scripts.text: Wait, but you already have a delivery box.
scripts.translation: 等等，你已經拿著一個配送箱了。

scripts.text: We can't allow you to deliver two boxes at once. So, please finish your delivery first.
scripts.translation: 不能同時配送兩個箱子。請先完成手上的配送任務。

scripts.text: If you forgot where to deliver, then please check Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation: 如果忘了配送地點，請按‘Alt + U’開啟任務視窗確認。

scripts.text: The insecticide? It must be the Zoologist on the southeast of Payon who ordered the Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 殺蟲劑？一定是斐揚東南方的動物學家訂購的。

scripts.text: Honey? It must be the Entomologist at the west of St. Capitolina Abbey, wich is northeast of Prontera who ordered the Honey.
scripts.translation: 蜂蜜？一定是普隆德拉東北方聖卡皮托利納修道院西側的昆蟲學家訂購的。

scripts.text: The blankets! It must be the biologist in the south of Lutie field who ordered the blankets.
scripts.translation: 毛毯！一定是盧蒂原野南邊的生物學家訂購的。

scripts.text: You can can go to Lutie by asking Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 你可以找艾爾帕蘭東北方的克勞斯先生前往盧蒂。

scripts.text: Dieshin's cooperation motive is to give the fastest and credited delivery. So please deliver it now without any delay.
scripts.translation: 遞信快遞的宗旨是快速、可靠地送達。請立即配送，別耽擱。

scripts.text: If you forgot where to make the delivery, then please check the Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation: 如果忘了配送地點，請按‘Alt + U’開啟任務視窗確認。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Have you heard of a monster named Bigfoot?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過一種叫大腳熊的魔物嗎？

scripts.text: It looks like a bear with red fur and has a 'X' shape scar on his shoulder.
scripts.translation: 它像一頭紅毛熊，肩上有一道X形傷疤。

scripts.text: According to the recent research, flies and Bigfoot monsters have a symbiotic relationship.
scripts.translation: 近期研究發現，蒼蠅和大腳熊之間存在共生關係。

scripts.text: I am currently studying about it and try to prove the theory. So I plan to kill the flies around Bigfoot and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究並試圖證明這個理論，所以打算消滅大腳熊周圍的蒼蠅，觀察它的反應。

scripts.text: Oh, I need an Insecticide to continue the study.
scripts.translation: 哦，我需要殺蟲劑才能繼續研究。

scripts.text: You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation: 你不是遞信快遞的配送員嗎？

scripts.text: I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation: 我在等一件特別的包裹。

scripts.text: That is the Insecticide that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation: 這就是我訂購的殺蟲劑！你是遞信快遞派來的吧？

scripts.text: I have been waiting for this!
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!
scripts.translation: 比我想像中送得快多了。我想馬上測試！

scripts.text: Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！非常感謝！這是給你的一點小禮物。

scripts.text: Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我還以為遞信快遞既快又可靠，沒想到你送來一個空箱子。真令人失望。

scripts.text: Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation: 請把我訂購的東西送來。遞信快遞會把貨物交給你。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the Horn monster?
It's shaped like an insect with black sleek skin and it has a giant horn it's head.
scripts.translation: 它長得像昆蟲，皮膚烏黑光滑，頭上有一根巨大的角。

scripts.text: Recent research came out and showed that this monster can be tamed and trained by Honey.
scripts.translation: 最近的研究顯示，這種魔物可以用蜂蜜馴服和訓練。

scripts.text: I am currently studying about it and trying to prove the theory. So I plan to set a Honey trap on the places he usually passes and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究並試圖證明這個理論，所以打算在它經常出沒的地方放置蜂蜜陷阱，觀察它的反應。

scripts.text: Oh, I need Honey to continue the study.
scripts.translation: 哦，我需要蜂蜜才能繼續研究。

scripts.text: You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation: 你不是遞信快遞的配送員嗎？

scripts.text: I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation: 我在等一件特別的包裹。

scripts.text: That is the Honey that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation: 這就是我訂購的蜂蜜！你是遞信快遞派來的吧？

scripts.text: I have been waiting for this!
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!
scripts.translation: 比我想像中送得快多了。我想馬上測試！

scripts.text: Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！非常感謝！這是給你的一點小禮物。

scripts.text: Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我還以為遞信快遞既快又可靠，沒想到你送來一個空箱子。真令人失望。

scripts.text: Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation: 請把我訂購的東西送來。遞信快遞會把貨物交給你。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the Marin monster?
It does look like the usual poring, but it has unique characteristic.
scripts.translation: 它看起來和普通波利相似，卻有獨特的習性。

scripts.text: Porings steal items if they see them on the ground. However, Marin has no interest in dropped items. So I was wondering, how come Marin doesn't pay attention to gathering items even though they are the same kind of monster as Porings.
scripts.translation: 波利看到地上的物品就會偷走，但瑪琳對掉落物毫無興趣。我一直在想，既然瑪琳和波利是同類魔物，為什麼它們不撿東西呢？

scripts.text: But, this place is freaking cold.
scripts.translation: 不過，這裡真是冷得要命。

scripts.text: Huh, whatever. But be careful! It's very slippery here.
scripts.translation: 唉，算了。小心點！這裡很滑。

scripts.text: You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation: 你不是遞信快遞的配送員嗎？

scripts.text: I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation: 我在等一件特別的包裹。

scripts.text: Those are the Blankets that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation: 這就是我訂購的毛毯！你是遞信快遞派來的吧？

scripts.text: I have been waiting for this!
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test them right away!
scripts.translation: 比我想像中送得快多了。我想馬上試試！

scripts.text: Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！非常感謝！這是給你的一點小禮物。

scripts.text: Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我還以為遞信快遞既快又可靠，沒想到你送來一個空箱子。真令人失望。

scripts.text: Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation: 請把我訂購的東西送來。遞信快遞會把貨物交給你。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so many items?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation: 你是在參加訓練課程嗎？

scripts.text: Here is some hair~ a broken clock~!
scripts.translation: 這裡有些頭髮~還有壞掉的時鐘~！

scripts.text: Hey~! Dude! You look like a very rich adventurer.
scripts.translation: 嘿~！老兄！你看起來像個很有錢的冒險者。

scripts.text: Really? Hmm, oh right. You don't look sophisticated.
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？嗯，哦對。你看起來不怎麼體面。

scripts.text: You are a poor adventurer~! Good luck!
scripts.translation: 你是個窮冒險者~！祝你好運！

scripts.text: Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是伊甸園集團的人嗎？

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation: 你還沒完成任務，怎麼回來了？

scripts.text: You don't have enough 'Skel-Bones'... You can find it when you hunt Skeletons.
scripts.translation: 你的骷髏骨頭不夠...狩獵骷髏就能獲得。

scripts.text: To find Skeletons, you better check Payon Dungeon 1F, which is located in Archer Village, north of Payon.
scripts.translation: 骷髏可以在斐揚北邊的弓箭手村附近，也就是斐揚地下城1樓找到。

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: But, where is the Bear's Footskins and Animal Skins?
scripts.translation: 不過，熊掌皮和動物外皮呢？

scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation: 你還沒完成任務，怎麼回來了？

scripts.text: You have to bring 10 Bear's Footskins' and '5 Animal Skins!
scripts.translation: 你得帶來10個熊掌皮和5個動物外皮！

scripts.text: You can find Bear's Footskin from Bigfoot and Animal Skin from Animals.
scripts.translation: 大腳熊會掉落熊掌皮，動物會掉落動物外皮。

scripts.text: Bigfoot is around the north of Geffen field or the southeast of Payon field.
scripts.translation: 大腳熊出沒在吉芬原野北部和斐揚原野東南部。

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: But, where are the Worm Peelings and Garlets?
scripts.translation: 不過，蟲蛹皮和傑勒比結晶呢？

scripts.text: You have to bring '20 Worm Peelings' and '20 Garlets' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任務需要帶來20個蟲蛹皮和20個傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text: You can get those items from 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro', 'Vitata', 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug'.
scripts.translation: 這些物品可以從‘畢帝特地龍’、‘安德烈’、‘丹尼羅’、‘維塔塔’、‘盜蟲’、‘盜蟲♀’和‘盜蟲♂’身上獲得。

scripts.text: 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro' and 'Vitata' are in Ant Hell which is located near the Saint Darmain Fortress soutwest of Morocc.
scripts.translation: ‘畢帝特地龍’、‘安德烈’、‘丹尼羅’和‘維塔塔’在夢羅克西南方聖達曼要塞附近的螞蟻地獄裡。

scripts.text: 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug' are int he Prontere Culvert. To get there, you need to be a volunteer of the Prontera Culvert's punitive force.
scripts.translation: ‘盜蟲’、‘盜蟲♀’和‘盜蟲♂’在普隆德拉下水道。要進入那裡，你必須加入普隆德拉下水道討伐隊。

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: But, where are the Yoyo Tails, Acorns and Raccoon Leafs?
scripts.translation: 不過，悠悠猴尾巴、橡果和浣熊葉呢？

scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation: 你還沒完成任務，怎麼回來了？

scripts.text: You have to bring '10 Yoyo Tails,' '10 Acorns' and '10 Raccoon Leafs' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任務需要帶來10個悠悠猴尾巴、10個橡果和10片浣熊葉。

scripts.text: You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.
scripts.translation: 悠悠猴會掉落悠悠猴尾巴，可可會掉落橡果，狸貓會掉落浣熊葉。

scripts.text: You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.
scripts.translation: 它們在各地原野都很常見，不過斐揚東邊的原野最適合狩獵這三種魔物。

scripts.text: To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.
scripts.translation: 要去阿育他亞，最好找艾爾貝塔的‘艾巴克辛’付費搭船。

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: But, where are the Well-baked Cookies and the Piece of Cake?
scripts.translation: 不過，烤得恰到好處的餅乾和蛋糕塊呢？

scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation: 你還沒完成任務，怎麼回來了？

scripts.text: You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任務需要帶來5塊烤得恰到好處的餅乾和1塊蛋糕。

scripts.text: You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
scripts.translation: 穿紅色或綠色衣服的餅乾會掉落烤得恰到好處的餅乾。

scripts.text: For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.
scripts.translation: 蛋糕塊可以從禮物箱身上取得。

scripts.text: Both monsters canbe found in the Toy Factory Warehouse or Toy Monitoring Room. To get there, ask Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 這兩種魔物都在玩具工廠倉庫或玩具監控室。找艾爾帕蘭東北部的克勞斯先生就能前往。

scripts.text: I can see that you have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我看得出來你接了採集任務。

scripts.text: But, where are the Mole Whiskerss and Mole Claws??
scripts.translation: 不過，摩爾鼠的鬍鬚和爪子呢？

scripts.text: You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation: 你還沒完成任務，怎麼回來了？

scripts.text: You have to bring '5 Mole Whiskers' and '3 Mole Claws' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任務需要帶來5根摩爾鼠鬍鬚和3只摩爾鼠爪。

scripts.text: You can get those items from 'Martins'.
scripts.translation: 這些物品可以從摩爾鼠身上獲得。

scripts.text: Martins can be found in the Mjolnir Dead Pit, but the second floor is dangerous, so be careful!
scripts.translation: 摩爾鼠出沒在妙勒尼礦坑，不過二樓很危險，要小心！

scripts.text: To get there, ask a Kafra Employee in Geffen, they can warp you there.
scripts.translation: 找吉芬的卡普拉職員，她可以把你傳送過去。

scripts.text: Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation: 總之我會在這裡等你。完成任務後再回來！

scripts.text: Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation: 咦？你確定嗎？好像有哪裡不對...

scripts.text: Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation: 按‘Alt + U’開啟任務視窗確認一下。

scripts.text: Wow~ you did an excellent job!
Thank you very much. God bless you!
I will give you a reward as promised.
scripts.translation: 我會按照約定給你報酬。
